Name: NPC_PARTS_PARAM_ST
Description: Enemy parts: breakable or separately damaged parts of an enemy, with their own HP, damage multipliers, hit materials, SpEffects, guard settings and lock-on dummy polys.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Network Test Version
Fields.Description: Exclude this row from the network test build.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Release Version
Fields.Description: Exclude this row from the retail build.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Reserve 1
Fields.Description: Reserved package export flag.

Fields.Name: Disable Param: Reserve 2
Fields.Description: Reserved package export flag.

Fields.Name: Event Part ID
Fields.Description: ID given to the part instance that is created, used to refer to it from events.

Fields.Name: Part Group Index
Fields.Description: Part group ID: the part ID in the character's damage part setup (pwv).

Fields.Name: Hit Marker Type
Fields.Description: Type of hit marker shown on the HUD when this part is hit.

Fields.Name: Part HP
Fields.Description: HP of the part.

Fields.Name: Part Damage Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplier applied to damage dealt to this part.

Fields.Name: Part Bullet Damage Multiplier
Fields.Description: Bullet multiplier: applied to damage dealt to this part.

Fields.Name: Owner Damage Multiplier
Fields.Description: Multiplier applied to the damage passed on to the main character body.

Fields.Name: Defence Material: Sound
Fields.Description: Defence material for sound effects, used for hit effects and similar.

Fields.Name: Defence Material: Particle
Fields.Description: Defence material for particle effects, used for hit effects and similar.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: On Hit
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied when this part is hit.

Fields.Name: SpEffect ID: On Break
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied at the moment the part's HP falls to 0 or below.

Fields.Name: Is Invincible
Fields.Description: If ON, the part is invincible and takes no damage.

Fields.Name: Disable Lock-on After Break
Fields.Description: If ON, the part can no longer be locked on to once it is destroyed.

Fields.Name: Guard Enabled
Fields.Description: If ON, guarding is effective on this part.

Fields.Name: Pulse Armor Guard Enabled
Fields.Description: If ON, Pulse Armor guarding is effective on this part.

Fields.Name: Physical Shield Guard Enabled
Fields.Description: If ON, guarding with a physical shield is effective on this part.

Fields.Name: Force Ricochet Bullet Effect on Hit
Fields.Description: If ON, bullets hitting this part always show the ricochet effect. Intended for parts with the heavy steel body or shield materials.

Fields.Name: Auto Sight Display Type
Fields.Description: Type shown on the auto sight cursor for this part.

Fields.Name: Lock-on Dummy Poly
Fields.Description: Dummy poly used as the lock-on point of the part.

Fields.Name: HP Gauge Dummy Poly
Fields.Description: Dummy poly where the part's HP gauge is displayed.

Fields.Name: Owner Impact Multiplier
Fields.Description: When this part is hit, the final impact value is multiplied by this before it is accumulated.

Fields.Name: SpEffect on Hit: Part Condition Label
Fields.Description: Label for the part condition of on-hit SpEffects. When an attack uses the part condition for SpEffect 0, the SpEffect is only applied if the hit is on a part with the same label.
